notablePrerequisites: Arbor Elf does not have summoning sickness.
easyPrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Arbor Elf.
Blighted Burgeoning attached to a Forest you control.
description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
The triggered ability from the Aura triggers, adding an additional {U}.
Activate the Aura attached to Arbor Elf by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may add other colors in step 3.
